name: Going Out Out
source:
“Do I really need to go out tonight…?”

Phoenix is about to head out with her friends to a local gay bar and things were going well until she had a sudden wave of self-doubt. Act as Phoenix’s subconscious to help guide her through her thoughts as she waits for her taxi to arrive. 

[from [url=https://rottentief.itch.io/going-out-out]itch.io[/url]]
